relations: A hand entering from the left extends a thin stick toward the central burning twigs.
The stick held near the fire is exposed to the flickering orange-yellow flames.
The hand withdrawing removes the stick, leaving only the burning campfire in the frame.
The fire continues to flicker while the surrounding rocks, tree, and bench remain motionless.
caption: The video captures an outdoor campfire burning within a rough ring of mossy rocks on a dirt, leaf-strewn clearing. A tree trunk and the legs of a wooden bench stand in the background. A small pile of twigs burns at the center, its orange-yellow flames flickering and shifting in height throughout. A person's hand and forearm enter from the left edge; a thin stick is then extended rightward toward the burning pile. The hand holds the stick there while the fire burns around it, then opens, and the stick is no longer held out. The empty hand retreats leftward and leaves the frame entirely. Afterward only the fire remains, still flickering, while the rocks, ground, tree and bench legs stay motionless under a static camera.
